remarks: Attention First Time Home Buyers, Investors, and Snowbirds! This condo is the perfect investment for you! Nestled in the beautiful neighbourhood of Summerwood which is within walking distance of shopping, groceries, transit, and trails, this home is sure to impress! As you arrive to this third floor unit, you will immediately notice the UPDATED luxurious vinyl plank flooring that floods the open concept kitchen and living room! The U-shaped kitchen has a great amount of counter and cupboard space for all of your cooking needs! Just off the kitchen you will find the dining nook that can also be used for a den, or for extra storage! The living room has large WEST facing windows that overlooks you spacious balcony! This condo is also home to two great size bedrooms and two 4pc bathrooms, so no one has to share! You will also find a stackable washer and dryer in your unit as well! Now the cherry on top is the HEATED UNDERGROUND parking stall that is titled to you! Do not miss out on this great opportunity! (id:67522)
